title: Faster charge accumulation can consume earlier structure
statement: For the introduced20mm/50um dense-volume equivalent, target charge1.06849125C does not manufacture that shape. Without regeneration A loses8.8867%;4mA regeneration avoids sampled erosion but overplates A2.3194%. Joining old B at100s changes the shared potential and immediately oxidizes B at .651611583mA: target arrives387.504s while B loses17.526% and A gains3.730%. Kinetic blocking or a common field guard alone do not keep both old inventories within1%. These are finite model cases, not reliability data.
